def compile_mjcf(facts, out):
    links = facts['links']
    rels = facts['relations']
    pairs = [
      ('input_shaft','base'),('input_shaft','lower_input_bearing'),('input_shaft','upper_input_bearing'),('input_shaft','carrier_bearing'),('input_shaft','carrier'),('input_shaft','fixed_ring'),('input_shaft','sun_gear'),('input_shaft','planet_1'),('input_shaft','planet_2'),('input_shaft','planet_3'),('input_shaft','input_crank'),('input_shaft','crank_grip'),('input_shaft','planet_pin_1'),('input_shaft','planet_pin_2'),('input_shaft','planet_pin_3'),
      ('sun_gear','fixed_ring'),('sun_gear','planet_1'),('sun_gear','planet_2'),('sun_gear','planet_3'),('sun_gear','carrier'),('sun_gear','input_crank'),('sun_gear','planet_pin_1'),('sun_gear','planet_pin_2'),('sun_gear','planet_pin_3'),('sun_gear','carrier_bearing'),('sun_gear','upper_input_bearing'),('sun_gear','crank_grip'),('sun_gear','lower_input_bearing'),('sun_gear','base'),
      ('carrier','carrier_bearing'),('carrier','planet_pin_1'),('carrier','planet_pin_2'),('carrier','planet_pin_3'),('carrier','fixed_ring'),('carrier','planet_1'),('carrier','planet_2'),('carrier','planet_3'),('carrier','upper_input_bearing'),('carrier','lower_input_bearing'),('carrier','ring_post_1'),('carrier','ring_post_2'),('carrier','ring_post_3'),('carrier','base'),('carrier','input_crank'),('carrier','crank_grip'),
      ('planet_1','planet_pin_1'),('planet_1','fixed_ring'),('planet_1','planet_2'),('planet_1','planet_3'),('planet_1','input_crank'),('planet_1','carrier_bearing'),('planet_1','upper_input_bearing'),('planet_1','crank_grip'),('planet_1','lower_input_bearing'),('planet_1','base'),('planet_1','planet_pin_2'),('planet_1','planet_pin_3'),('planet_1','ring_post_1'),('planet_1','ring_post_3'),
      ('planet_2','planet_pin_2'),('planet_2','fixed_ring'),('planet_2','planet_3'),('planet_2','input_crank'),('planet_2','carrier_bearing'),('planet_2','upper_input_bearing'),('planet_2','crank_grip'),('planet_2','lower_input_bearing'),('planet_2','base'),('planet_2','planet_pin_1'),('planet_2','ring_post_1'),('planet_2','ring_post_2'),
      ('planet_3','planet_pin_3'),('planet_3','fixed_ring'),('planet_3','input_crank'),('planet_3','carrier_bearing'),('planet_3','upper_input_bearing'),('planet_3','crank_grip'),('planet_3','lower_input_bearing'),('planet_3','base'),('planet_3','planet_pin_1'),('planet_3','ring_post_2'),('planet_3','ring_post_3'),
      ('input_crank','crank_grip'),('input_crank','planet_pin_1'),('input_crank','planet_pin_2'),('input_crank','planet_pin_3'),('input_crank','fixed_ring'),('input_crank','carrier_bearing'),('input_crank','upper_input_bearing')]
    unique = []
    seen = []
    for a,b in pairs:
        p = sorted([a,b])
        k = p[0]+'|'+p[1]
        if k not in seen:
            seen.append(k)
            unique.append(p)
    rp = {}
    for r in rels:
        p = sorted([r['base_part'],r['incoming_part']])
        rp[p[0]+'|'+p[1]] = r
    keeps = ['base|input_shaft','crank_grip|input_crank']
    contacts = []
    for p in unique:
        k = p[0]+'|'+p[1]
        src = ['link/'+p[0],'link/'+p[1]]
        fids = ['nearby/'+p[0]+'/'+p[1], 'pair/'+p[0]+'/'+p[1]]
        if k in rp:
            r = rp[k]
            src.append('relation/'+r['name'])
            fids.append('relation/'+r['name'])
            fids.append('fit/'+r['base_part']+'/'+r['base_port']+'/'+r['incoming_part']+'/'+r['incoming_port'])
            reason = 'Exact authored '+r['mate_type']+' interface is represented by rigid carrying, a hinge, or an ideal gear equality; contact would fight it.'
            action = 'exclude'
        elif k in keeps:
            reason = 'Measured surfaces touch or overlap is unavailable; preserve contact rather than hide uncertain real contact.'
            action = 'keep'
        else:
            reason = 'Measured real meshes have positive surface separation and no contact-dependent function; exclude this collision-proxy false-contact risk.'
            action = 'exclude'
        contacts.append({'pair':p,'action':action,'reason':reason,'source_entity_ids':src,'fact_ids':fids})
    cm = {'input_shaft':'sun_input_hinge','sun_gear':'sun_input_hinge','input_crank':'sun_input_hinge','crank_grip':'sun_input_hinge','carrier':'carrier_output_hinge','planet_pin_1':'carrier_output_hinge','planet_pin_2':'carrier_output_hinge','planet_pin_3':'carrier_output_hinge','planet_1':'planet_1_carrier_hinge','planet_2':'planet_2_carrier_hinge','planet_3':'planet_3_carrier_hinge','fixed_ring':None}
    for n in ['base','lower_input_bearing','upper_input_bearing','carrier_bearing','ring_post_1','ring_post_2','ring_post_3']:
        cm[n] = None
    plan = {'coordinate_map':cm,
      'tree_edges':[['base','lower_input_bearing'],['base','upper_input_bearing'],['base','carrier_bearing'],['base','ring_post_1'],['base','ring_post_2'],['base','ring_post_3'],['base','fixed_ring'],['base','input_shaft'],['input_shaft','sun_gear'],['input_shaft','input_crank'],['input_crank','crank_grip'],['base','carrier'],['carrier','planet_pin_1'],['carrier','planet_pin_2'],['carrier','planet_pin_3'],['carrier','planet_1'],['carrier','planet_2'],['carrier','planet_3']],
      'closure_edges':[['sun_gear','carrier'],['sun_gear','planet_1'],['fixed_ring','planet_1'],['sun_gear','planet_2'],['fixed_ring','planet_2'],['sun_gear','planet_3'],['fixed_ring','planet_3']],
      'rigid_carried':[['input_shaft','sun_gear'],['input_shaft','input_crank'],['input_crank','crank_grip'],['carrier','planet_pin_1'],['carrier','planet_pin_2'],['carrier','planet_pin_3']],
      'independent_coaxial':[['input_shaft','carrier'],['sun_gear','carrier'],['sun_gear','fixed_ring']],
      'transmissions':[['sun_input_hinge','carrier_output_hinge',0.25],['sun_input_hinge','planet_1_carrier_hinge',-0.75],['sun_input_hinge','planet_2_carrier_hinge',-0.75],['sun_input_hinge','planet_3_carrier_hinge',-0.75]],
      'contact_decisions':contacts,'support_ground':['base'],'support_strategy':'The fixed base and its structural supports remain ground-collidable; no support-probe alteration is needed.'}
    out.topology_plan(plan)
    out.body('base')
    for n in ['lower_input_bearing','upper_input_bearing','carrier_bearing','ring_post_1','ring_post_2','ring_post_3','fixed_ring']:
        out.body(n,'base')
    out.body('input_shaft','base')
    out.joint('input_shaft','sun_input_hinge',kind='hinge',axis=(0,0,1),pos_mm=(0,0,18.2),frame='world')
    out.body('sun_gear','input_shaft')
    out.body('input_crank','input_shaft')
    out.body('crank_grip','input_crank')
    out.body('carrier','base')
    out.joint('carrier','carrier_output_hinge',kind='hinge',axis=(0,0,1),pos_mm=(0,0,13.5),frame='world')
    for i in [1,2,3]:
        out.body('planet_pin_'+str(i),'carrier')
    anchors = [(18.0,0.0,18.2),(-9.0,15.588457268119896,18.2),(-9.0,-15.588457268119893,18.2)]
    for i in [1,2,3]:
        n = 'planet_'+str(i)
        j = n+'_carrier_hinge'
        out.body(n,'carrier')
        out.joint(n,j,kind='hinge',axis=(0,0,1),pos_mm=anchors[i-1],frame='world')
    eqsrc = ['planetary_stage/four_to_one_planetary_stage']
    out.joint_equality('planetary_carrier_ratio','sun_input_hinge','carrier_output_hinge',0.25,reason='Fixed 54-tooth ring and 18-tooth sun give carrier speed sun/(1+54/18).',sources=eqsrc,fact_ids=eqsrc)
    for i in [1,2,3]:
        s = ['transmission/sun_to_planet_'+str(i),'transmission/planet_to_internal_ring_'+str(i),'planetary_stage/four_to_one_planetary_stage']
        out.joint_equality('planetary_planet_ratio_'+str(i),'sun_input_hinge','planet_'+str(i)+'_carrier_hinge',-0.75,reason='Equal-tooth external mesh plus fixed internal ring gives local planet spin -3/4 sun.',sources=s,fact_ids=s)
    for c in contacts:
        if c['action'] == 'exclude':
            out.exclude(c['pair'][0],c['pair'][1],c['reason'],c['source_entity_ids'],c['fact_ids'])
    allids = facts['entity_ids']
    for e in allids:
        if e.startswith('link/'):
            nodes = [e[5:]]
            act = 'emitted'
        elif e.startswith('motion_joint/'):
            nodes = [e[13:]]
            act = 'emitted'
        elif e.startswith('transmission/'):
            t = e[13:]
            if t.startswith('sun_to_planet_'):
                nodes = ['planetary_planet_ratio_'+t[-1]]
            else:
                nodes = ['planetary_planet_ratio_'+t[-1]]
            act = 'represented_by'
        elif e.startswith('planetary_stage/'):
            nodes = ['planetary_carrier_ratio','planetary_planet_ratio_1','planetary_planet_ratio_2','planetary_planet_ratio_3']
            act = 'represented_by'
        elif e == 'role/driver/input_shaft' or e == 'role/watch/sun_gear' or e == 'role/watch/input_crank':
            nodes = ['sun_input_hinge']
            act = 'represented_by'
        elif e == 'role/output/carrier' or e == 'role/watch/carrier':
            nodes = ['carrier_output_hinge']
            act = 'represented_by'
        elif e.startswith('role/watch/planet_'):
            nodes = [e[11:]+'_carrier_hinge']
            act = 'represented_by'
        elif e.startswith('relation/'):
            r = rp.get('')
            nodes = []
            for q in rels:
                if 'relation/'+q['name'] == e:
                    if q['name'].startswith('sun_planet_mesh_') or q['name'].startswith('ring_planet_mesh_'):
                        nodes = ['planetary_planet_ratio_'+q['name'][-1]]
                    elif q['name'] == 'carrier_on_support_bearing':
                        nodes = ['carrier_output_hinge']
                    elif q['name'].startswith('planet_pin_journal_'):
                        nodes = ['planet_'+q['name'][-1]+'_carrier_hinge']
                    elif q['name'] in ['shaft_in_lower_bearing','shaft_in_upper_bearing','sun_press_fit','crank_press_fit']:
                        nodes = ['sun_input_hinge']
                    else:
                        nodes = ['carrier_output_hinge']
            act = 'represented_by'
        elif e.startswith('pose/place_'):
            nodes = [e[11:]]
            act = 'represented_by'
        elif e.startswith('port/'):
            nodes = [e.split('/')[1]]
            act = 'represented_by'
        else:
            nodes = []
            act = 'represented_by'
        out.decision(e,action=act,generated_nodes=nodes,reason='Authored fact is represented in the emitted body tree, coordinates, ideal constraints, or pair-specific contact classification.',fact_ids=[e])
